Chapter 1185 - 7 Galaxy Venerate (Request Subscription) _2

Chapter 1185: Chapter 7 Galaxy Venerate (Request Subscription) _2

The ancient and venerable Heavenly Venerates, under the gaze of this young man, seemed like two ants.

"Galaxy Great Lord?"

Beiyin Venerable Sage immediately recognized the identity of the young man, none other than Galaxy Great Lord guarding this Hei Yu Nest.

"Have we been discovered?"

Jihan Venerate’s expression turned stern, as the personal arrival of Galaxy Great Lord combined with the protection over all the Hei Yu around made it easy to deduce this conclusion.

"This Galaxy Venerate was already prepared for us?"

Jihan Venerate thought to himself, meanwhile looking towards Beiyin Venerable Sage, wanting to know the next course of action.

"Leave."

Though Beiyin Venerable Sage felt a bit unwilling, he knew that given the current situation, immediate retreat was the best option.

Without retreating, they couldn’t take away the Hei Yu in a short time, making staying pointless.

Buzz!

Beiyin Venerable Sage moved his thoughts. Since they had already been discovered, there was no need to completely conceal their presence, as long as they didn’t expose their signature killing moves, they didn’t have to worry.

Whoosh!

Time and space began to boil as Beiyin Venerable Sage attempted to forcibly penetrate the space-time passage from this place to the outside world, intending to make an exit.

However.

The power of the great array surged, immediately suppressing Beiyin Venerable Sage’s attempt to pierce through time and space.

"Galaxy Great Lord?"

Beiyin Venerable Sage looked at Lin Yuan, "You still want to keep us here?"

Beiyin Venerable Sage frowned, paid no more attention, and then unhesitatingly flew towards the outside.

Since blasting through the space-time passage for a rapid retreat was not possible, then they would just fly out directly.

The defensive array of Hei Yu Nest was primarily designed to defend against external attacks, and as for internal security?

It could at least not stop a strong figure like Beiyin Venerable Sage.

"Suppress."

Seeing this scene, Lin Yuan fully unleashed the Divine Ability ’World’.

Whoosh!

The vast outer universe spread out like an ocean, instantly filling every inch of space inside Hei Yu Nest.

"What is this?"

Jihan Venerate’s expression changed dramatically as he clearly felt completely suppressed, even flying became extremely difficult.

Under such suppression, not to mention exiting Hei Yu Nest in three breaths, even thirty breaths or three hundred breaths would be impossible.

"Not good."

Beiyin Venerable Sage’s face turned grim, realizing through the omnipresent domain suppression that Galaxy Great Lord’s strength far exceeded his predictions, even having stepped into the Heavenly Venerable Realm.

"No more holding back."

Beiyin Venerable Sage unhesitatingly began employing all his means to escape.

The formless terrifying Yin aura spread all around, attempting to counter the outer universe’s suppression, and in this moment Beiyin Venerable Sage held nothing back, even risking exposing his true identity.

As a Heavenly Venerate of the Xuanyin Ancient Country, taking unauthorized action against the supreme treasure land of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country broke the unwritten rules between the two ancient nations.

If word got out, he would surely face punishment from the Xuanyin Ancient Country, but no matter how severe the punishment, it would be lighter than losing this physical form.

And right now.

Beiyin Venerable Sage had a feeling that if he didn’t fight with all his might, he wouldn’t be able to break free from the outer universe’s suppression. As time dragged on, waiting for reinforcements from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country could lead to his live capture and suppression.

As a Heavenly Venerable, breaking unwritten rules in secret, the Xuanyin Ancient Country would, for its dignity, definitely punish him, but not too severely since he was one of their own.

But if he were captured alive, the Xuanyin Ancient Country would lose face immensely, and the punishment against him would have no limits.

Rumble.

Beiyin Venerable Sage began burning the Origin Source of his flesh, trying to break the surrounding space-time suppression, but found it had little effect as the rolling suppressive power came crashing down like a grindstone.

Unmatchable.

Unstoppable.

Beiyin Venerable Sage was shocked within.

"Galaxy Great Lord..."

Beiyin Venerable Sage turned his gaze to Lin Yuan, who was overlooking him, suddenly speaking, "Perhaps I should call you... Galaxy Venerate?"

Given the scale of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, the emergence of a Heavenly Venerate was exceedingly rare but not inconceivable.

After all, the Fierce Sun Ancient Country had a large number of peak Great Lords just a step away from the Heavenly Venerable Realm, ready to break through at any moment.

But Lin Yuan?

Lin Yuan was recognized as core royalty of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

For a core royal to become a Heavenly Venerate, the significance was entirely different from other newly emerged Heavenly Venerates.

"Galaxy Venerate?"

Not far away, Jihan Venerate as well stared at Lin Yuan, his mind churning with turmoil. Had Lin Yuan broken the legend that core royalties of various ancient countries could not surpass the Heavenly Venerate shackle?

Lin Yuan gazed down at Beiyin Venerable Sage and Jihan Venerate without speaking.

Displaying Heavenly Venerate-level power was something Lin Yuan had long planned.

Having already surpassed the typical limits of core royals, Lin Yuan’s entry into the Heavenly Venerable Realm wasn’t entirely unbelievable.

Both the Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country and King Chibao were very eager for Lin Yuan to break the royal’s Heavenly Venerate shackle.

"This time, I’ve truly lost."

Beiyin Venerable Sage gave Lin Yuan a deep glance, then his body and soul began to dissipate.

With Beiyin Venerable Sage’s strength, he could definitely sustain himself under Lin Yuan’s outer universe suppression for some time.

After all, at this moment, Lin Yuan’s true form wasn’t present but only the Taiyin Primordial Spirit, so the power wasn’t overwhelming enough to easily crush a Heavenly Venerate.

However, every moment of delay could mean reinforcements from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country at any time.

Should the reinforcement come from one of those few Peak Venerables of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, Beiyin might not even be able to self-dissipate.

In this situation, for safety’s sake, Beiyin Venerable Sage chose to abandon this main battle body.

"Beiyin."

Jihan Venerate, witnessing this scene, felt a tremor in his heart.

He clearly understood why Beiyin Venerable Sage chose to self-dissipate his body.

"Try again."

In Jihan Venerate’s eyes, a faint blood-red hue appeared, and his surroundings were engulfed in freezing cold that pierced through time and space. But facing the power of Lin Yuan’s outer universe, all of this quickly dissipated.

"Forget it."

After almost ten breaths, Jihan Venerate too found the struggle hopeless, realizing escape was impossible in the short term.

He also began to dissipate his body and soul.

Soon.

The bodies and souls of the two ancient Heavenly Venerates disappeared completely.

Lin Yuan watched silently without interruption.

In fact, he couldn’t stop them, not when he himself was only the Taiyin Primordial Spirit.

Even his true self would have difficulty preventing a Heavenly Venerate from willingly dissolving their body.

In the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan had suppressed Black Light Great Saint, Wild Barbarian Great Saint, and a multitude of Chaos Great Saints, but that was because they were just outmaneuvered; given a chance to reclaim their bodies, they naturally would.

However, in the Fang Yuan World? Most Heavenly Venerates had already sworn loyalty to the six ancient countries, facing capture by an enemy ancient country would have appalling consequences.

The higher their status, the more severe the consequences of being captured by an enemy country would be.

The greater their position, the more severe the punishment would be, especially if they got captured alive and suppressed.

Those like the Spirit Might King and King Lingshen would rather extinguish their primary battle bodies than be captured, due to the dire consequences.

"That’s acceptable."

Lin Yuan felt rather satisfied, forcing a Heavenly Venerate to annihilate his own body and soul was no easy feat.

On a battlefield, it’s hard to achieve such a level of pressure where a Heavenly Venerate wouldn’t resist for some time, but it was accomplished here in the Hei Yu Nest under unique circumstances.

In addition to Beiyin Venerable Sage and Jihan Venerate’s unpublicized identities, the timely threat of reinforcements from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country pressured them towards self-destruction rather than risking capture by Lin Yuan.

"It’s quite satisfactory."

If it had been in the battlefield, compelling a Heavenly Venerate to voluntarily annihilate their body and soul would be incredibly difficult.

Unless one could single-handedly sweep through all enemies, but that’s very difficult, as each ancient country would resort to its deep-seated hands to counter.

It was only here at the Hei Yu Nest that Beiyin Venerable Sage and Jihan Venerate’s identities remained in the shadows, compounded by the imminent arrival of Fierce Sun Ancient Country reinforcements, that left them choosing to relinquish their main battle bodies.

Lin Yuan set his eyes on the spots where the two Heavenly Venerates had dissipated.

Several weapons and world secret treasures had fallen.

"What a chance to finally witness the secret techniques of Xuanyin Ancient Country."

Lin Yuan’s eyes sparkled. His path was the Taiji Dao, and the legacy from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country has greatly aided his Taiyang Dao.

He thus eagerly anticipated the many Xuanyin inheritances from the Xuanyin Ancient Country.
